$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (2026-08-17). Themes S1-S7 were proposed in derivation/source-comptia-practice-v7.md (the T1-T8 architecture starter set fits this operations exam poorly — no autonomy-level or trust-boundary judgments exist at this altitude) and are ratified here; theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. pattern_extensions are the mechanisms both Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + frequency evidence in the two Artefact A docs). E04 acronym-decoy-expansion is DELIBERATELY NOT DECLARED: both artefacts propose it as a banned construction (0/30 vendor wrong options vs 72/435 community; a fabricated expansion tests the acronym table, not an objective), and omission is the structural ban — any item tagging E04 fails the pattern-registry check. The E-numbering skips E04 so the artefacts' labels stay citable. Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as organisational settings for scenarios — none is copied from a source scenario.

theme_definitions.S1: Concept identification — name the concept, category, control type or actor behind a described situation
theme_definitions.S2: Control selection — pick the control that meets a stated requirement, against near neighbours that meet adjacent requirements
theme_definitions.S3: Indicator diagnosis — reason from observed symptoms back to the attack or mechanism that produces them
theme_definitions.S4: Architecture trade-off — choose the architecture, deployment or protection option under a stated constraint (availability, cost, patchability, responsibility)
theme_definitions.S5: Process-stage placement — place an activity in the right stage of a defined process: incident response, change management, vulnerability management, forensics
theme_definitions.S6: Governance & risk judgment — risk treatment, quantitative risk arithmetic, agreement selection, compliance obligation
theme_definitions.S7: Evidence selection — pick the log, data source or artefact that can answer the investigative question asked
